name: Yaegashi Miri
source: Miri is an instructor at a swimming school close to the school the main characters attend who loves swimming and often goes to pools and the sea during her free time as well. She is half-Japanese, half-Nordic and popular with her students and their parents alike. She has a tough outlook, but in reality wants to be an obedient, passive wife who would do anything for her husband in the future.
